hooks.command: count=$(gh issue list --repo mgfv2r2mpv-hash/tools-nooutco-me --label bug --state open --json number 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(len(json.load(sys.stdin)))' 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; then printf 'CRITICAL: %s unresolved Generate Note API error(s) in production.\nRun: gh issue list --repo mgfv2r2mpv-hash/tools-nooutco-me --label bug --state open\n' "$count"; echo '{"continue":true,"suppressOutput":false}'; else echo '{"continue":true,"suppressOutput":true}'; fi
